steps.name: shell
steps.arg:
"ffmpeg -y -hide_banner -loglevel error -i song.m4a -ac 1 -ar 22050 analysis.wav && python3 - <<'PY'
import wave, numpy as np
w=wave.open('analysis.wav','rb'); sr=w.getframerate(); x=np.frombuffer(w.readframes(w.getnframes()),np.int16).astype(np.float32)/32768
# frame features at 20 fps
hop=sr//20; win=2048
rows=[]
for i in range(0,len(x)-win,hop):
 s=x[i:i+win]*np.hanning(win)
 sp=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(s)); f=np.fft.rfftfreq(win,1/sr)
 rms=np.sqrt(np.mean(s*s)); total=sp.sum()+1e-9
 centroid=(sp*f).sum()/total
 low=sp[(f>=40)&(f<220)].sum()/total; mid=sp[(f>=220)&(f<2000)].sum()/total; high=sp[(f>=2000)&(f<9000)].sum()/total
 rows.append((i/sr,rms,centroid,low,mid,high))
a=np.array(rows)
# print 1-sec RMS/centroid/bands
for sec in range(35):
 z=a[(a[:,0]>=sec)&(a[:,0]<sec+1)]
 print(f'{sec:02d}-{sec+1:02d} rms={z[:,1].mean():.4f} peak={z[:,1].max():.4f} cent={z[:,2].mean():.0f} low={z[:,3].mean():.2f} mid={z[:,4].mean():.2f} high={z[:,5].mean():.2f}')
# onset proxy spectral flux, top times
S=[]
for i in range(0,len(x)-win,hop): S.append(np.abs(np.fft.rfft(x[i:i+win]*np.hanning(win))))
S=np.array(S); flux=np.maximum(0,np.diff(S,axis=0)).sum(1); flux/=flux.max()+1e-9
peaks=[]
for i in range(1,len(flux)-1):
 if flux[i]>.24 and flux[i]>=flux[i-1] and flux[i]>=flux[i+1] and (not peaks or i-peaks[-1]>3): peaks.append(i)
print('onsets', ' '.join(f'{(p+1)/20:.2f}' for p in peaks))
PY"

steps.text: 频谱显示这是持续推进、打击点密集的电子/流行质感，尾部在约 33 秒后明显收束。视觉方向定为“信号穿越”：从微光粒子进入几何隧道，再展开为有机光环与碎片化高潮，最后随尾音熄灭；全片无外部素材、无多余字幕。

import wave,numpy as np
w=wave.open('analysis.wav','rb'); sr=w.getframerate(); x=np.frombuffer(w.readframes(w.getnframes()),np.int16).astype(float)
hop=256; win=1024
S=[]
for i in range(0,len(x)-win,hop): S.append(np.abs(np.fft.rfft(x[i:i+win]*np.hanning(win))))
S=np.array(S); env=np.maximum(0,np.diff(S,axis=0)).sum(1); env-=env.mean()
ac=np.correlate(env,env,mode='full')[len(env)-1:]
for bpm in range(70,181):
 lag=round((60/bpm)*sr/hop)
 if bpm%5==0: pass
scores=[(ac[round((60/b)*sr/hop)],b) for b in np.linspace(70,180,1101)]
print(sorted(scores,reverse=True)[:12])
PY"
